title: How to disable netplan.io and use NetworkManager alone?

I don't want to use Netplan as an additional abstraction layer, so I usually just uninstalled it instead of figuring out how to solve problems with Netplan. However, since 23.10, netplan.io seems to be a dependency of network-manager:

# apt remove netplan.io

For reference, I'm trying this now on Ubuntu Server 24.04.1 LTS (Noble Numbat). I have checked other threads like this one, but I could not find any mentions on how to get rid of Netplan on recent Ubuntu versions, without also removing Networkmanager.
